notes: readCache counts hits and misses; takeCacheStats answers and resets both counters.
installDiskRead and writeThrough emit installed; writeThrough and advanceFreshnessCursor advance writeGeneration; writeThrough and advanceFreshnessCursor clear lastReadFileStats.

enable caches the opener's promise and its outcome: settled without an error resolves, settled with one rejects with that value; reloadThroughStorageOnce spends the owed flag exactly once and answers the same promise afterwards.
beginPendingWrite/endPendingWrite keep a per-file account; an end without a begin answers 0 (the source's ?? 1 fallback).
bootPhaseStillOpen closes at the deadline and stays closed; claimParseErrorLog dedups until clearParseErrorDedup; remoteControlMachineIdOnceFrom computes once until cleared.
Hh chains work per key, removes the key when its chain settles, and drain waits at most five rounds so work queued while running is picked up.
